proof_body:
by
  intro a C r _ hr h
  have hu : ∀ n, dist (a n) (a (n + 1)) ≤ C * r ^ n := fun n => by
    rw [dist_comm, Real.dist_eq]; exact h n
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (cauchySeq_of_le_geometric r C hr hu)
  refine ⟨L, hL, fun n => ?_⟩
  have := dist_le_of_le_geometric_of_tendsto r C hr hu hL n
  rwa [Real.dist_eq] at this
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (C r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → r < 1 → (∀ n, |a (n + 1) - a n| ≤ C * r ^ n) → ∃ L : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds L) ∧ ∀ n, |a n - L| ≤ C * r ^ n / (1 - r)
